title: Intention-to-Practice Follow-Through
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session intention_logged=yes
| stats sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as completed, count as intentions by practice_type
| eval follow_through_pct=round(100*completed/intentions,1)
| sort - follow_through_pct
description: Compares how often logged intentions for prayer or meditation turn into completed sessions.
value: Intentions feel meaningful, but follow-through is where rhythms are actually formed.
implementation: Track intended and completed sessions in `prayer:session`; calculate follow-through percentage by practice type.
visualization: Table of practice types with intention follow-through percentage.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It spots how often the sessions you planned to do actually happen.
